requirements_summary.scope: Hybrid fixer-output generator for completed scan top-three gaps.
requirements_summary.gating: Selected waitlisted users behind server-side env gates: FIX_PACK_ENABLED plus beta allowlisted user IDs/emails.
requirements_summary.primary_output: Cursor/Claude Code optimized copy-paste prompt, downloadable Markdown agent file, and fix assets.
requirements_summary.prd_decision: Use Fix Pack as the v1 product framing; separate fixer page is the recommended canonical experience, with gap-card and scan-summary CTAs as entry points.
requirements_summary.latest_refinement: Add a downloadable Markdown agent file users can insert into Claude Code or Cursor for iterative SEO/AEO optimization; defer auto-research capability to a later enhancement.
requirements_summary.competitive_research_decision: Primary wedge is the scan-grounded implementation bridge; use builder-first Markdown agent delivery, top-three scope, AEO-specific assets, and prompt/download instrumentation as supporting differentiators.
requirements_summary.prd_refinement_before_design: Design should center on three fix cards plus an agent-guide install panel. Product copy should emphasize scan-grounded repair briefs, not generic AI SEO automation.
requirements_summary.design_decision: Use a scan-report-native layout: report CTA -> Fix Pack page -> three fix cards -> sticky prompt/download/install rail. Keep the Fix Pack on the dark report surface and align typography, rules, marginalia, and accent usage with the existing landing and scan pages.
requirements_summary.design_review_status: Static prototype revised for GEOlens brand consistency; deterministic checks and focused code review passed with browser visual review still pending before implementation.
requirements_summary.api_impact_decision: Use env-based server gates for v1 beta (FIX_PACK_ENABLED plus allowlisted user IDs/emails), persist one Fix Pack per completed scan in scan_fix_packs, expose GET/POST /api/v1/scans/[id]/fix-pack plus GET /agent.md, and implement /scan/[id]/fix-pack as the canonical owner-only page.
